mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, question_id, due_date, status, generated_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM review_queue WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND due_date = #{today} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY generated_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_queue (student_id, question_id, due_date, status, generated_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{generatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
